description:
This file is a PHP source code for a controller class named ECB, which manages currency data, fetches exchange rates from the European Central Bank (ECB), and provides functionalities to view and save currency configurations within the OpenCart admin extension.

It includes methods to load currency data, update currency exchange rates via an external feed, and integrates with the OpenCart MVC framework, utilizing models, views, and session data.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing ECB currency exchange rates, including fetching rates from ECB's XML feed, updating currency codes, and settings related to currency exchange rates within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency exchange rate configuration page, loads necessary language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updated currency exchange rates by fetching current rates from the ECB XML feed, updating currency values, and clearing the currency cache. Includes permission checks.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches the latest exchange rates from the ECB if enabled in settings, processes the XML response, updates currency values in the database based on a specified default currency, and manages currency cache.
